_doc: Shared FE/BE conformance fixture for the two phyletic-profile encoders. One clade tree, one set of selections, one expected binding per case. The backend reads it in apps/api/src/pathfinder/tests/unit/test_phyletic_conformance.py and the frontend in apps/web/src/features/strategy/editor/widgets/phyleticConformance.test.ts. Edit both tests when adding cases. A case carries either the three expected values or an `unresolved` block. `tsSkip` marks a case the widget cannot express, and `tsSkipReason` says why. The `decode` section states both readings of a pattern: `census` is what the wire guard reads and `widget` is what the editor reads, and they are written separately because the two decoders have different jobs.
_term_map_doc: A depth-first walk, as WDK emits it. The three WDK-SITE-004 pairs sit where tree order and code order disagree: bant precedes atum, yepe precedes wsuc, and hsap precedes atum. An encoder that keeps vocabulary order is wrong on all three.
_indent_map_doc: One entry shorter than the term map, because the root carries no depth. Live on plasmodb.org on 2026-08-30 both vocabularies are 903 rows and neither carries a root row, and each entry names its parent in a third column the fixture leaves null.

cases.name: a single species is one include token
an excluded clade becomes its leaves
an explicit leaf overrides the clade above it
atum sorts before bant although the tree lists bant first
atum sorts before hsap although the tree lists hsap first
wsuc sorts before yepe although the tree lists yepe first
an empty selection is the bare wildcard and two markers
nested clades expand to every leaf below them
a deeper clade overrides the clade above it
a pure exclusion writes no include token
an unselected sibling stays out of the pattern
a code in both lists binds nothing
cases.tsSkipReason: The widget holds one tri-state per code in a Map and has no refusal path: reopening a stored step with a conflicted code leaves that code unconstrained and names it in a notice. Only the backend, which binds two independent proposals before a step exists, can refuse.

cases.name: a display label resolves to its code
a label matches without regard to case
an unknown term is named rather than dropped

decode.name: reads back the pattern the encoders write
a many-species pattern reads every token
another site's grammar is not a census
decode.note: The published initialDisplayValue. The wire guard answers a 422; the editor shows nothing selected and regenerates the pattern, which is what the reference client does on form load.

decode.name: a code with no state is not a census
a third state letter is not a census
an empty value is not a census
a code stated twice is not a census
decode.note: One species has one state in the census. The wire guard names the repeated code in a 422; the editor's Map keeps the last token, and the pattern it writes back holds that one state.

decode.name: an uppercase clade code
decode.note: The wire guard reads a clade token so it can expand it to the leaves the census holds (WDK-SITE-005). The editor reads only lowercase leaf codes, which is every code the census carries and every code either encoder writes.
